== Published English Original Virtual Set 3 wording ==
The original makes cleanup compulsory when Hem is lost or missing. The later version omits missing and describes cleanup during the control phase or if Hem is lost as optional. Both retain the face-down card per deploy phase, cumulatively +1 total battle destiny per card and movement to Used Pile.
